MANDARIN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Interactive Speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Interactive Speaking.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Interactive Speaking.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Interactive Speaking.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Interactive Speaking.

2. When practising Active Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Active Listening.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Active Listening.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Active Listening.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Active Listening.

3. When practising Oral Expression, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Oral Expression.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Oral Expression.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Oral Expression.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Oral Expression.

4. In MANDARIN, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Mix random languages with no purpose
   B. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   C. Avoid speaking to classmates
   D. Only memorise without using the language

5. When practising Oral Expressions, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Oral Expressions.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Oral Expressions.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Oral Expressions.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Oral Expressions.

6. When practising Reading Aloud, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading Aloud.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Reading Aloud.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading Aloud.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Reading Aloud.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
7. In three clear sentences, explain Oral Expression and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

8. In three clear sentences, explain Oral Expression and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

9. In three clear sentences, explain Oral Expressions and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

10. In three clear sentences, explain Interactive Speaking and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
